name: ALARM.getAlarmPercentage

name: ALARM.randomReset

name: collisionInfo.getCollidingShapeIDList
description: Returns the other-side shape IDs as an integer-list iterator.
returns_note: Copies the signed-key-ordered shape IDs. If an existing INTLISTREFCONTAINER is supplied, it is cleared and reused.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"iterator","type":"INTLISTREFCONTAINER","description":"Optional iterator object to clear and refill.","optional":"when supplied"}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms allocation or reuse and ordered list filling. The iterator methods match the recovered table; backing storage representation differs.

name: collisionInfo.getContactNormalOfMyCollidingShape
description: Returns the normal for the first contact involving the supplied shape ID.
returns_note: Searches collision groups in signed-key order. Returns the first matching normal, or (0, 1) when no record matches.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"myShapeID","type":"int","description":"Shape ID on this side of the collision."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms the raw signed ID and default normal. Contact order and direction remain runtime-open.

name: collisionInfo.getEntity
description: Returns the other entity in this collision pair.
returns_note: Returns the collision record's stored other entity, or null if unavailable.
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms conversion from the pair's other PhysicsData object to its owning Entity.

name: collisionInfo.getFirstShapeCollisionInfo
description: Returns the first shape-group collision record, or null when there are none.
returns_note: Uses signed shape-ID key order. Returns the same cached ShapeCollisionInfo view as getShapeCollisionInfo for that key.
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms returning null for an empty map and the leftmost stored record otherwise. Local cached views preserve aliasing.

name: collisionInfo.getNumCollidingShapes
description: Returns the number of other-shape groups in this collision record.
returns_note: Each group corresponds to one other-side shape ID.
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms this reads the group count; local grouping and ID list use the same entries.

name: collisionInfo.getShapeCollisionInfo
description: Returns the shape-group collision record for a shape ID, or null if absent.
returns_note: Looks up the signed shape ID and returns a cached view of that stored group.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"shapeID","type":"int","description":"Other-side shape ID used as the group key."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms signed-key lookup and null-on-miss behavior. Local cached views preserve identity between lookups.

name: collisionInfo.isAllSensors
description: Checks whether all other-side shapes in this collision record are sensors.
returns_note: Returns 1 when every other-side shape is a sensor. An empty record returns 1; an unresolved shape ID is treated as a sensor.
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms the live sensor query and empty-map result.

name: collisionInfo.isBodyColliding
description: Checks whether a PhysicsBody has any shape ID in this collision record.
returns_note: Returns 1 if a shape belonging to the body occurs on either side of a stored contact, otherwise 0.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"body","type":"PhysicsBody","description":"Body to test against this collision record."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms checking the body's shape IDs against the outer keys and each contact record's other shape ID.

name: collisionInfo.isBodyCollidingWithBody
description: Checks whether a contact in this record involves either of two supplied bodies.
returns_note: Returns 1 when a stored contact has a shape belonging to either body on both sides, otherwise 0.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"body1","type":"PhysicsBody","description":"First body to test."},{"index":1,"name":"body2","type":"PhysicsBody","description":"Second body to test."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms the two-body shape ownership checks in either contact orientation.

name: collisionInfo.isBodyCollidingWithShape
description: Checks whether a body is colliding with a specific shape ID.
returns_note: Returns 1 when the specified shape ID and a shape owned by the body occur on opposite sides of a stored contact, in either orientation; otherwise 0.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"body","type":"PhysicsBody","description":"Body to test."},{"index":1,"name":"shapeID","type":"int","description":"Shape ID to test against the body."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms both contact orientations and raw signed shape ID handling. It does not recheck whether the native contact is currently touching.

name: collisionInfo.isMyShapeCollidingWithSensorsOnly
description: Checks whether all contacts for one of this body's shapes are with sensor shapes.
returns_note: Returns 1 when every matching contact's other shape is a sensor. Returns 1 when there are no matching contact records; unresolved other shapes are treated as sensors.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"myShapeID","type":"int","description":"Shape ID on this side of the collision."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms filtering by the raw signed shape ID and querying the other shape's live sensor flag.

name: collisionInfo.isShapeColliding
description: Checks whether a shape ID occurs on either side of any contact in this record.
returns_note: Returns 1 when the ID matches an outer other-side shape ID or an inner shape ID, otherwise 0.
parameters_json: [{"index":0,"name":"shapeID","type":"int","description":"Shape ID to search for."}]
parameters_note: Retail PPC confirms signed raw-ID matching on either side of the contact records.
